description: Reproducibility manifest for HaorWatch U-Net model bundles. Model weights are NOT stored in Git (backend/models/ and *.pt are gitignored). This manifest records the expected artifact filenames, checksums and metadata so a deployment can verify a bundle obtained from the artifact source.

artifact_source.detail: Bundles are produced by scripts.train_model --register <src_dir> from the Kaggle training outputs and stored under backend/models/unet/<version>/. Weights are not redistributed in Git; obtain them from the project's model artifact store (or regenerate from the documented Kaggle notebooks) and place them at backend/models/unet/<version>/.

0.4.0.dataset: Hakaluki AOI S1/S2 same-day pairs, Sentinel-2 MNDWI>0 pseudo-labels (fine-tune of 0.1.0)
0.4.0.s1_unit_provenance: Fine-tuned from 0.1.0 which declares s1_unit=dB; fine-tune normalized inputs with the 0.1.0 norm_stats.json (dB). Metadata completed during staging validation; weights unchanged.
